newsitem.title: USA: Option Care to speed up acquisition plan.
newsitem.headline: Option Care to speed up acquisition plan.

text.p: Option Care Inc, a home healthcare provider with 184 franchised and company-owned locations nationwide, said Wednesday it plans to accelerate its acquisition strategy in 1997.

"The company is negotiating to acquire several additional home healthcare businesses and expects to accelerate its acquisition strategy in 1997," Erick "Rick" Hanson, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Option Care completed three acquisitions in the third quarter and 12 during the first nine months of the year.
Earlier, Option Care reported third quarter earnings of $0.09 a share, up from $0.08 last year. Revenues rose 10 percent to a record high of $17.8 million.
Improved results were due primarily to a 19 percent percent increase in patient care services revenue generated by company-owned offices.
Royalty revenue declined six percent in the third quarter as the company purchased franchises and some other franchises were terminated.
